title: I got banned

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your punishment, I've decided to deny your appeal. Mainly due to the fact your infraction is very recent, you got punished yesterday. Plus, your infractions page doesn't show us that you properly obeyed the rules much, you have 10 excessive infractions disregarding the perm ban. I'm sorry, but I'm afraid you'd have to wait 6-8 to have a proper chance of getting appealed.

Thanks!
